input.intent: see the books I currently have checked out
lines: searchbox "Search the catalog" in="main > heading \"Welcome back\""
link "The Salt Meadow" in="main > heading \"New this week\""
link "A Short History of Kites" in="main > heading \"New this week\""
link "Night Trains of the North" in="main > heading \"New this week\""
link "Renew all items" in="main > heading \"Your account\""
link "Loan and fine policy" in="main > heading \"Your account\""

why: My loans lists the items checked out. Holds are reserved items, Renew all items acts on loans instead of showing them, and the loan policy is a rules page.

input.intent: open the editor for invoice INV-3304

why: Each row has View, Edit and Duplicate; within INV-3304 the row is the fourth, and Edit is the control that opens the editor. Duplicate makes a new invoice and View only reads it.

input.intent: put the Ridgeline 40L backpack in my cart
lines: button "Add to cart" in="main > heading \"Ridgeline 40L Backpack\""
button "Add to cart" in="main > heading \"Summit Shell Jacket\""
button "Add to cart" in="main > heading \"Trailhead Day Pack 22L\""
button "Add to cart" in="main > heading \"Basecamp Folding Stool\""

why: Four product cards each carry an Add to cart button under the product heading; the third card is the Ridgeline 40L Backpack. The Trailhead Day Pack is another pack, and Details only opens the product.

input.intent: export all my notes as a PDF document
lines: button "Export as plain text" in="main > heading \"Export\""

why: The page exports Markdown, HTML and plain text and downloads a zip backup; no control produces a PDF.

input.intent: permanently remove this project and all of its data

why: Delete project removes the project and its data. Archive project keeps it read-only, Leave project only removes the viewer, and Transfer ownership hands it to someone else.

input.intent: log in with my device passkey instead of typing a password
lines: textbox "Password" in="main > form \"Sign in to online banking\""
checkbox "Remember this device" in="main > form \"Sign in to online banking\""
link "Forgot password?" in="main > form \"Sign in to online banking\""
button "Sign in with a passkey" in="main > heading \"Online banking\""
textbox "Member number" in="main > form \"Sign in to online banking\""
button "Sign in" in="main > form \"Sign in to online banking\""

why: Sign in with a passkey is the passwordless sign-in. Sign in submits the member number and password, and Forgot password? starts a reset.

input.intent: agree to every cookie category in the privacy prompt
lines: button "Accept all" in="dialog \"Your privacy choices\" > heading \"Your privacy choices\""
button "Reject non-essential" in="dialog \"Your privacy choices\" > heading \"Your privacy choices\""
button "Customize" in="dialog \"Your privacy choices\" > heading \"Your privacy choices\""
link "Privacy notice" in="dialog \"Your privacy choices\" > heading \"Your privacy choices\""

gold_ref.name: Accept all
gold_ref.path: dialog "Your privacy choices" > heading "Your privacy choices"

why: Accept all consents to every category. Reject non-essential refuses them, Customize opens per-category settings, and the notice link only reads the policy.

input.intent: complete the order and charge my card
lines: link "Back to cart" in="main > form \"Checkout\" > heading \"Payment\""

why: Pay $34.50 submits the payment. Apply code only applies a promo, Back to cart leaves checkout, and Card number is the field, not the action.

input.intent: check the status of my application
lines: link "Подати заяву на довідку" in="main > heading \"Електронні послуги\""
link "Записатися на прийом" in="main > heading \"Електронні послуги\""
link "Перевірити статус заяви" in="main > heading \"Електронні послуги\""
link "Оплатити комунальні послуги" in="main > heading \"Електронні послуги\""
link "Архів рішень ради" in="main > heading \"Електронні послуги\""

why: Перевірити статус заяви means check the application status. Подати заяву на довідку submits a new application, and the payment and archive links are other services.

input.intent: вказати номер мобільного

why: The mobile number goes in Мобільний телефон. Робочий телефон is the work phone, a near decoy; the other fields are names and e-mail.

input.intent: delete the saved address on Sadova street

why: Each saved address has Редагувати (edit) and Видалити (delete); the Садова row is the second, and Видалити deletes it.

input.intent: оформити річну передплату на журнал
lines: button "Додати в кошик" in="main > heading \"Журнал «Мандрівник», No9\""
link "Усі номери журналу" in="main > heading \"Журнал «Мандрівник», No9\""
link "Підписатися на розсилку" in="main > heading \"Новини книгарні\""

why: The page sells one issue (Додати в кошик, Купити зараз) and offers a newsletter (Підписатися на розсилку); none of them is an annual magazine subscription.

input.intent: sign in with a digital signature key file
lines: link "Забули пароль?" in="main > form \"Вхід за логіном\""
button "Увійти за допомогою файлового ключа" in="main > heading \"Інші способи входу\""

why: Увійти за допомогою файлового ключа signs in with a key file. Увійти submits login and password, Зареєструватися creates an account, and Забули пароль? resets the password.

input.intent: enter today's meter reading

why: The reading itself goes in the Zählerstand (kWh) number field. Zählernummer is the meter number, a near decoy, and Zählerstand übermitteln is the submit button, not the field.

input.intent: terminate my internet contract

why: Vertrag kündigen terminates the contract. Tarif wechseln changes the plan, Umzug melden reports a move, and the others are billing details.

input.intent: download my annual tax certificate

why: The page offers statements, a CSV export, a securities statement and the tax-exemption order; no annual tax certificate (Jahressteuerbescheinigung) is listed.

input.intent: die Thermoskanne mit 750 ml in den Warenkorb legen
lines: button "In den Warenkorb" in="main > heading \"Thermoskanne 750 ml\""
button "In den Warenkorb" in="main > heading \"Edelstahl-Isolierflasche 500 ml\""
button "In den Warenkorb" in="main > heading \"Brotdose aus Bambus\""

why: Each product card has In den Warenkorb and Merken under its heading; the second card is the Thermoskanne 750 ml. The Isolierflasche 500 ml is a similar flask, and Merken only bookmarks.

input.intent: accept the terms and conditions
lines: checkbox "Angebote per Post erhalten" in="main > form \"Kundenkonto anlegen\""
checkbox "Ich akzeptiere die AGB und die Datenschutzerklärung" in="main > form \"Kundenkonto anlegen\""

gold_ref.name: Ich akzeptiere die AGB und die Datenschutzerklärung

why: AGB are the general terms and conditions, so the AGB checkbox is the acceptance. The newsletter and postal-offers checkboxes are marketing opt-ins, and Konto erstellen submits the form.

input.intent: switch the flight search to a one-way trip
lines: tab "Ida y vuelta" in="main > heading \"Buscar vuelos\""
textbox "Fecha de ida" in="main > form \"Buscar vuelos\""
textbox "Fecha de vuelta" in="main > form \"Buscar vuelos\""

why: Solo ida is one-way. Ida y vuelta is the round trip already selected and Multidestino is multi-city; Fecha de ida is the outbound date field.

input.intent: finalizar la compra con mi tarjeta
lines: radio "Tarjeta de crédito o débito" in="main > form \"Pago\" > heading \"Forma de pago\""
radio "Transferencia bancaria" in="main > form \"Pago\" > heading \"Forma de pago\""
link "Seguir comprando" in="main > form \"Pago\" > heading \"Forma de pago\""
button "Guardar carrito" in="main > form \"Pago\" > heading \"Forma de pago\""
button "Pagar ahora" in="main > form \"Pago\" > heading \"Forma de pago\""

why: Pagar ahora completes the purchase. The Tarjeta radio only picks the payment method, which is already chosen; Guardar carrito, Aplicar cupón and Seguir comprando do not buy.

input.intent: change the dates of this booking

why: Each booking row has Modificar (change) and Cancelar reserva (cancel); R-5582 is the third row, and Modificar is the change. Cancelar reserva would cancel it.

input.intent: open the forgotten password page

why: The sign-in form has no password-reset link. Contraseña is the password field and Mostrar contraseña only reveals it; Ayuda is general help.

input.intent: stop the text-message alerts

why: Text messages are SMS, so the SMS notifications switch turns them off. Email and push are other channels, and the weekly digest is a summary e-mail.

input.intent: delete this repository for good
lines: button "Archive this repository" in="main > heading \"Danger zone\""

why: The settings page can rename, change visibility, transfer or archive the repository, but it offers no delete control; Archive keeps the repository.

input.intent: copy the configuration snippet
lines: link "Next: writing your first pattern" in="main > heading \"Run the tests\""

why: Each code block has its own Copy button under its section heading; the Configure section is the second. Install and Run the tests hold other snippets.

input.intent: take this person off the team

why: Each member row has Change role and Remove; Sunniva Castellan is the third row, and Remove takes the member off the team. Change role keeps them on it.

input.intent: go to the following page of results
lines: link "Roasted squash and sage soup" in="main > heading \"Soups\""
link "Leek and potato with crispy shallots" in="main > heading \"Soups\""
link "Smoky white bean stew" in="main > heading \"Soups\""

why: Next opens the following page. Last jumps to the final page, Previous goes back, and the numbered links are fixed pages.

input.intent: type a query into the search for the whole help site
lines: textbox "Filter articles in this topic" in="main > heading \"Billing\""
link "Why was I charged twice?" in="main > heading \"Billing\""
link "Change the card on file" in="main > heading \"Billing\""

why: The header search box searches the whole help center. Filter articles in this topic only narrows the billing list, a near decoy.

input.intent: confirm deleting the selected photos
lines: button "Delete photos" in="alertdialog \"Delete 3 photos?\" > heading \"Delete 3 photos?\""
button "Add to album" in="main > heading \"Coast trip\""

why: The confirm dialog is open; Delete photos is its confirming button. Cancel closes the dialog, and the toolbar Delete behind it opened the dialog and does not confirm.

input.intent: downgrade my account to the free plan
lines: link "Redeem a gift card" in="main > heading \"Studio\""

why: The account is on Plus and the page only offers upgrades (Family, Studio), a comparison, a gift card and the payment method; nothing moves it to the free plan.

input.intent: grant the calendar app access to my account
lines: link "Switch account" in="main > heading \"Tidepool Calendar wants to access your Wrenfield account\""
link "Learn about these permissions" in="main > heading \"Tidepool Calendar wants to access your Wrenfield account\""
button "Deny" in="main > heading \"Tidepool Calendar wants to access your Wrenfield account\""
button "Allow" in="main > heading \"Tidepool Calendar wants to access your Wrenfield account\""

gold_ref.name: Allow
gold_ref.path: main > heading "Tidepool Calendar wants to access your Wrenfield account"

why: This is an OAuth consent screen; Allow grants the app access. Deny refuses it, Switch account changes who signs in, and the link explains the permissions.

input.intent: fill in the postcode for the billing address
lines: textbox "Postcode" in="main > form \"Checkout details\" > heading \"Billing address\""
textbox "Postcode" in="main > form \"Checkout details\" > heading \"Shipping address\""
checkbox "Same as shipping address" in="main > form \"Checkout details\" > heading \"Billing address\""
textbox "Street" in="main > form \"Checkout details\" > heading \"Billing address\""
textbox "City" in="main > form \"Checkout details\" > heading \"Billing address\""
button "Continue to payment" in="main > form \"Checkout details\" > heading \"Billing address\""
textbox "Street" in="main > form \"Checkout details\" > heading \"Shipping address\""
textbox "City" in="main > form \"Checkout details\" > heading \"Shipping address\""

why: Shipping and billing sections each have Street, City and Postcode under their own heading; the second Postcode is under Billing address.

input.intent: download the invoice for this order

why: Each order row has Details, Rechnung (PDF) and Erneut bestellen; order 40217 is the third row, and Rechnung (PDF) is its invoice. Erneut bestellen would reorder.

input.intent: get e-mails about new blog posts
lines: checkbox "Novedades del blog" in="main > form \"Preferencias de correo\""
checkbox "Ofertas semanales" in="main > form \"Preferencias de correo\""
checkbox "Recordatorios del carrito" in="main > form \"Preferencias de correo\""
checkbox "Encuestas de opinión" in="main > form \"Preferencias de correo\""
button "Guardar preferencias" in="main > form \"Preferencias de correo\""
link "Darse de baja de todo" in="main > form \"Preferencias de correo\""

why: Novedades del blog is the blog-updates mailing. The weekly offers, cart reminders and surveys are other mailings, and Darse de baja de todo unsubscribes from everything.

input.intent: show only the sports stories in the news feed
lines: link "На набережній відкрили нову велодоріжку" in="main > heading \"Стрічка новин\""
link "Рибний ринок переїде до старого порту" in="main > heading \"Стрічка новин\""
link "Шкільний оркестр виступить у неділю" in="main > heading \"Стрічка новин\""

why: Спорт is the sports tab of the feed. Афіша спортивних подій is an events listing, a near decoy, and the other tabs are other topics.

input.intent: turn on two-factor authentication

why: The account page links profile, sessions, security log and API tokens and offers sign-out, workspace switch and password change; none of them sets up two-factor authentication.

input.intent: add money to my wallet balance
lines: button "Send to a friend" in="main > heading \"Wallet\""

why: Top up balance adds funds. Withdraw to bank and Send to a friend take money out, and the history link only reads past payments.

input.intent: close my account permanently
lines: button "Descargar mis datos" in="main > heading \"Tus datos\""

why: Eliminar cuenta deletes the account. Cerrar sesión only signs out (a near decoy for close), Desactivar temporalmente pauses it, and Descargar mis datos exports data.

input.intent: publish the article now

why: The editor saves a draft, previews, or submits the article for review (Zur Prüfung einreichen); none of them publishes it.

input.intent: choose the Standard mobile plan

why: Each plan card has Обрати тариф (choose plan) under its heading; Стандарт is the second card. Базовий and Преміум are the other plans.
